QuestInfo.name: Nella's Second Request
QuestInfo.0: Nella has favor to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: Nella's afraid of Naora Hospital and wants to know if there really is a ghost there. Check it out for her...if you dare!
QuestInfo.2: You found Jane Doe, a girl with bandages on her head, in the Naora Hospital.

0.0: You hear the rumors about Naora Hospital? They say it's haunted.
0.1: N-not that I'm scared, of course! 'Cause I'm not! But could you check to see if the rumors are true?

yes.0: Okay, you check inside Naora Hospital and see if you find any ghosts. I'll hold down the fort here.

no.0: Don't tell me you're scared! Not that there's anything wrong with that...

1.1: Hello...? Where is Dr. Naora...? I'm supposed to get my bandages off today... Where did my doctor go...?

npc.0: W-well? Any news from Naora Hospital? It's not haunted, of course. Haha...
